answer: The three words are derived from a 191 bit value mixing the epoch seed with the identity key, so no two keys ever receive the same triple. Because the oasis nonce is published only after close, the island audit can verify each derivation and a shared text is provable as copied. That removes the entire premise of a template farm, which depends on one text serving many identities, and forces a separate relic derivation per key. That is 12 dollars per alias.
